---
title: "Mermaid built-in theme"
# bd-sehm2rha (GH #1296): `mermaid: theme:` selects one of mermaid's own
# themes and drops Quarto's themeCSS, as Quarto 1 does. Q1 documents the
# option under `format: html:`.
format:
  html:
    mermaid:
      theme: forest
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ["mermaid\\.initialize\\(\\{ startOnLoad: false, theme: \"forest\" \\}\\)"]
        - ["themeCSS"]
---

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  a --> b
```
